method: Each hour every aircraft heard in a 1° cell counts once: bad if it reported NACp < 8, NIC < 7 or readsb's GPS-lost marker, else good. MLAT, TIS-B and ADS-R positions and aircraft on the ground are left out. A cell needs at least 10 aircraft-hours; more than 10% bad is shown as interference.
note: Inferred from what aircraft report about their own navigation accuracy, not measured on the ground. Few aircraft means no data, not no jamming. Poor accuracy can also come from an aircraft's own equipment.
spoofing_note: Neither source marks spoofing, so this map does not tell jamming from spoofing.
